description: Read-only MCP server exposing the Cumulative Web Inc music catalog: search tracks, look up artists, semantic music search, knowledge graph, release facts, live radio, announcements, and featured tracks.
name: io.github.CumulativeWebInc/cwi-discovery-engine
title: CWI Discovery Engine

tools.description: Search the CWI placement catalog (That Boy Hi Hat + roster) by keywords. Title matches weigh 3x, genre 2x, mood 1x. Returns top 5 tracks with Spotify URLs and matched terms.
tools.name: search_catalog

tools.description: Look up one catalog track by title or Spotify ID/URL. Returns title, artist, Spotify URL, genres, and moods.
tools.name: get_track

tools.description: Look up an artist by name. Returns the artist and their tracks in the catalog with Spotify URLs.
tools.name: get_artist

tools.description: Search the CWI sync catalog for music-supervision queries like "fight scene" or "neon city". Built for film/TV/ad sync briefs.
tools.name: sync_search

tools.description: Semantic search over the catalog embedding matrix. Ask in plain English and get ranked results with real similarity scores.
tools.name: semantic_search

tools.description: Summarize the CWI catalog knowledge graph: 149 nodes, 269 edges covering tracks, artists, producers, releases, genres, and platforms.
tools.name: get_graph

tools.description: Fetch a CWI release fact packet: evidence-tiered, hash-stamped pre-release and release records with verified credits, dates, and platform links.
tools.name: get_release

tools.description: Tune into Cumulative Radio 365, CWI's 24/7 streaming radio station. Returns the live HLS stream URL, now-playing data, listener counts, and station metadata.
tools.name: get_radio

tools.description: Get the latest CWI announcements: new releases, upcoming drops, events, and news. Filter by category or get everything newest-first.
tools.name: get_announcements

tools.description: Get CWI's currently featured tracks with full metadata: title, artist, artwork URL, why it's featured, and stream/page links.
tools.name: get_featured
get_up_next
tools.description: See what's playing next on Cumulative Radio 365. Returns upcoming tracks with artist, title, artwork, start times, genres, moods, and Spotify URLs.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Get the full Cumulative Radio 365 program schedule. Returns all 131 slots with air times, tracks, and artists.

tools.name: request_song
tools.description: Request a song on Cumulative Radio 365. Provide track title, artist, your name, and optional reason/dedication. Goes to a review queue — does not auto-play. Max 3 requests per day.

tools.name: submit_for_airplay
tools.description: Submit a track for airplay consideration on Cumulative Radio 365. Provide artist name, track title, audio URL, contact info, and genre. Human review required before airplay.

tools.name: get_requests
tools.description: See the Cumulative Radio 365 song request queue. Filter by pending, played, or all.

tools.name: submit_sync_brief
tools.description: Submit a sync licensing brief to CWI. Describe the scene type, mood, budget range, and deadline. One signature clears the song (master + publishing). Human review.

tools.name: pitch_for_playlist
tools.description: Pitch a CWI catalog track for playlist consideration. Returns full track data package with genres, moods, Spotify URL, artwork, and stats.

tools.name: nominate_featured
tools.description: Nominate a CWI track for the featured rotation. Returns the track's auto-scored rubric score and queue position.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Get CWI track recommendations by describing a vibe (e.g. 'dark trap for night drive'). Returns ranked tracks with full metadata and why each matches.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Get upcoming CWI events: releases, listening parties, featured rotations. Returns event IDs, dates, descriptions, and links.

tools.name: rsvp
tools.description: RSVP to a CWI event. Provide event ID, your name, and contact info.
